'''Saaryu''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]] who was known to be an ace shooter. He was taking part in the [[Battle of Ottega]] to finish of [[Admiral Harkov's fleet]] that had defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. As the pilots were getting ready for the second stage of the battle, Saaryu was in a last minute exchange with fellow pilot [[Prakrii]] over their opinions of the [[Tractor beam/Legends|Tractor beam's]] use in battle.
